metadata.description: 16 MiB NPM unpacked-size cap (raised from 15 MiB on 2026-10-22: feature work had used the 15 MiB cap's headroom, leaving about 10 KB, and pack growth from the Android platform-capability tools was blocking every PR). The external source maps (about 9 MB, unused at runtime) still do not ship in the tarball (package.json files negation, enforced by packed-runtime-assets), so a regression that re-packs them (23,061,125 bytes) still fails by a wide margin
